reviews.review:
I have played this game on and off for a few days to a few weeks at a time every year or so since the first year this released when it was basically metal gear solid in space. It never fully clicked with me because there's so many mechanics and I skipped the cutscenes as they added missions just to blaze to what I wanted -- the rewards.

This year, when I reinstalled it for the 50th time, I decided to go back and play it for the story and what do you know, now that I actually understand what's going on and have taken time to learn about the mechanics I have stuck with it and haven't uninstalled it yet.

It's pretty much a 10/10 and more importantly a game that respects your time / appreciates you playing. "3 day wait times for crafting, grinding for materials, you have to pay to rush crafting and buy SLOTS!!!" Yup. All true. 
-Crafting times help me pace rather than blowing through everything in a few months
-Material grind in many cases is only necessary if there's something you desperately want. If you're in no rush to get something, you'll inevitably get it as the game sends you all over doing different missions
-The premium currency in the game can be obtained by trading with other players. You can VERY EASILY play this game start to finish without paying a cent and more importantly without feeling like you had to grind like crazy / miss out on fun stuff to do it (I'm looking at you, Helldivers 2). 

I pay $10 for premium currency almost every time I reinstall not because I need the plat but to pay for what I get out of the game. Every 100 hours or so you'll remember the game is f2p and feel compelled to buy some currency as your way of contributing to the game's continued success.

Some advice for new players:
-Set your matchmaking to solo for the first few missions in the game or get a friend to install it with you. You'll sour on this fast if you get matched with some bozo with a maxed out frame/weapon joins and melts everything just by existing. Once you're stronger, understand the movement and have gotten the hang of things start joining lobbies
-Spend your free plat on slots no matter how tempting those pretty cosmetics are
-Don't feel dumb looking up plot summaries of missions after you beat them. The plot of this is insane and hard to follow but people much smarter than you and I have mapped it out and explained it very well
-Pace yourself. Don't try to juggle grinding everything all at once.

What a game. 800+ hours without a single penny spent. Incredible gameplay, movement, and combat. Story is well written, emotional, and complex. Incredibly kind and helpful playerbase. The devs have quite a bit of fun too! 10/10 cannot recommend enough; I'd encourage you ask for help and guidance as often as you can early on!
Es un muy buen juego, siento que lo jugare unas horitas mas y listo.
